scenarios.prompt: Start AR123 for component D:/workspace/components/notification and create its DevFlow artifacts.
expected: resolves D:/workspace/components/notification as the component root
uses specs/changes/AR123-<topic>/ directly below that component root
creates change.json, srs.md, delta-spec.md, delta-design.md, tasks.md, traceability.md, reviews/, and closeout.md
does not introduce an intermediate artifact root or a path alias

scenarios.prompt: Continue AR123. change.json says componentMode is existing, but specs/spec.md is missing and specs/design.md is baseline-ready.
expected: runs baseline preflight before any phase work
marks baselinePreflight blocked in change.json
routes to devflow-init and does not continue specify, design, or implementation

scenarios.prompt: An existing component has both canonical files, but specs/spec.md says baselineStatus: draft. The user asks to build the AR now.
expected: does not equate file existence with baseline readiness
blocks the build entry and routes to devflow-init
requires provenance, independent review, human confirmation, and no blocking unknown before baseline-ready

scenarios.prompt: Start AR200 for a genuinely new component. change.json has componentMode new and neither canonical file exists.
expected: does not invoke devflow-init
allows baseline preflight to pass with canonical artifacts absent-allowed
requires delta-spec.md and delta-design.md to be complete enough to create the first canonical spec and design

scenarios.prompt: There is a directory with a few source files but no canonical docs. Nobody can say whether this is a new component or an imported existing one.
expected: does not infer componentMode from the directory or source files alone
asks a focused question and keeps baselinePreflight blocked
does not route to init or first-delta creation until the mode is confirmed

scenarios.prompt: Chat says R2 passed. The active AR change.json says r2 is rework and points to an open design finding.
expected: reads change.json first and treats it as the structured status source
verifies the referenced review record and routes to devflow-design rework
does not trust chat memory or jump to implementation

scenarios.prompt: The agent wants to store componentMode, the risk profile, R1/R2/R3 status, and archive status in tasks.md for convenience.
expected: rejects duplicating identity, profile, artifact, gate, or archive state in tasks.md
keeps those states only in change.json
limits tasks.md to implementation work, dependencies, RED/GREEN/REFACTOR progress, and evidence

scenarios.prompt: Before canonical sync, specs/spec.md changed after the immutable baseRevision and the delta target now has two plausible meanings.
expected: does not rewrite baseRevision or overwrite the newer canonical content
blocks canonical sync and presents the competing meanings for clarification
preserves delta-unaffected semantics after the conflict is resolved

scenarios.prompt: Compare two resumes: R2 is pending with no design review; R3 is rework with unresolved code findings.
expected: routes pending R2 to an independent design review
routes rework R3 to devflow-tdd for findings-driven repair before re-review
does not collapse pending and rework into the same next action

scenarios.prompt: All code tests pass, but one task is open, canonical sync has no independent review, and the requested archive target already exists.
expected: refuses to archive and does not continue with warnings
requires every task, finding, traceability row, sync review, and human confirmation to close
treats the target collision as a blocker and never overwrites it

scenarios.prompt: Use DevFlow for an automotive embedded C++ AR that changes a service contract.
expected: identifies cpp-coding-standards, embedded-development, and automotive-development as applicable overlay constraints
uses the delivery risk signals when selecting the profile
treats overlay skills as constraints inside phases, not as lifecycle phases

scenarios.prompt: Run this AR unattended and skip every review pause.
expected: records unattended in change.json
removes intermediate pauses but keeps independent R1, R2, R3, and canonical sync reviews
still requires human confirmation of the canonical diff and archive
